name: gigi-os
description: GIGI OS — homelab control center self-hosted

scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/agent && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/media && npm run build -w apps/files && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w apps/agent && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/media && npm run build -w apps/files && node --test --test-reporter=spec tests/*.test.mjs
